summary: This resolution condemns recent acts of violence against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and U.S. Customs and Border Protection personnel and facilities, while also thanking and honoring their service.

scores.thoughts: This resolution explicitly condemns attacks on U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) personnel and facilities, agencies central to immigration law enforcement and border security. By supporting these agencies and their mission, the bill strongly aligns with the 'Secure Borders' aspect of immigration policy.
